title: Titans put Peter Skoronski, Tommy Townsend on IR

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Titans put Peter Skoronski, Tommy Townsend on IR
sources.description: The Titans ruled left guard Peter Skoronski out on Friday due to a hamstring injury and his absence is going to last beyond this Sunday's game against the Jaguars.
